title: Golden Eval Q&A Item
description: Single question in the golden evaluation set with ground-truth expectations for retrieval and generation metrics.

question.description: Natural-language question posed to the RAG system.

expected_answer_contains.description: Substrings that a correct answer must include (case-insensitive check in eval runner).

expected_answer_excludes.description: Optional substrings that must NOT appear (e.g. hallucinated numbers).

source_doc_id.description: Expected primary source document for Recall@k measurement.

source_section.description: Expected section within the source document.

source_doc_ids.description: For cross-policy or multi-section questions — any of these docs in top-k counts as recall hit.

company_id.description: Company scope passed to the query API during eval.

policy_type.description: Optional hint for categorizing eval failures by policy domain.

difficulty.description: easy = single chunk; medium = multi-section; hard = cross-policy or version-specific.

answerable.description: false = system should refuse (I don't know); tests refusal accuracy.

category.description: Eval bucket aligned with architecture/operations golden set composition.

notes.description: Optional reviewer notes or generation provenance.
